preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must hold some tokens to demonstrate fee impact

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setTaxFeePercent(), setDevFeePercent(), and setLiquidityFeePercent() with values exceeding 25% (e.g., 30 each). Then perform a token transfer to trigger fee collection. The excessive fees will accumulate in the contract and can be extracted via swapAndLiquify mechanism, ultimately increasing the owner's ETH balance through DevAddress payments and liquidity additions.
